author: Joel
text:
everytime you doomscroll, you teach your nervous system that your needs are already fulfilled.

you consciously know your scrolling ruins your life—but your body doesn’t.

it just thinks: phone = novelty, connection, excitement, purpose.

but it’s artificial.

teach your nervous system (body) that being in the world, speaking to real people, going through real hardships is the real way to achieve your dreams.

if you don’t, you’ll easily waste another year with 7+hrs of screen time per day.

topReplies.author: Julius
topReplies.text: Most people do not use social media, but are being used by it.

topReplies.author: Kyle Patrick
topReplies.text:
Agreed. 

The disconnect between "knowing" and subconscious habits is kind of crazy. We "know" so many things are bad for us yet we cave to the impulse anyway. Awareness isn't enough - it has to translate to disruptive behaviors to interrupt the pattern.
